title: Market strip: CNN Fear & Greed with score, label and scale; SPX symbol fixed
changes: The Fear & Greed tile now reads the CNN index directly, then through two public CORS proxies; only if all fail it falls back to the crypto index, marked CRYPTO
The tile shows the number, the CNN rating such as EXTREME FEAR, a colour scale from 0 to 100 with a pin, and a 30 day sparkline
SPX tile uses FOREXCOM:SPXUSD because SP:SPX showed a symbol not available message; tiles are taller (46px)
Cache key moved to anav.fng.v2 (30 minutes)
